name: Parallel-Twin Crankshaft
description: Parallel-twin crankshaft with an 86 mm stroke: three 50 mm main journals, two 180-degree throws with counterweighted webs, and a six-bolt flywheel flange.

steps.instruction: Create the front main journal on the X axis.

steps.instruction: Add the first crank throw with its pin offset +43 mm.

steps.instruction: Add the second crank throw, 180 degrees from the first.

steps.instruction: Add counterweight lobes opposite each crank pin.
